question: Khelo India Para games (2023) were held in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The opening ceremony will be held at the KD Jadhav Indoor Hall located at Indira Gandhi Sports Complex.
 
• Position: Maharashtra secured the fifth position in the Khelo India Para Games 2023.
 
• Medal Haul: Maharashtra athletes won a total of 35 medals, with the breakdown being:
 
• Gold medals: 12
 
• Silver medals: 7
 
• Bronze medals: 16
 
• Comparison with other states:
 
 
• Haryana emerged champions with a total of 105 medals.
 
• Uttar Pradesh finished second with 62 medals.
 
• Tamil Nadu secured the third spot with 42 medals.
